summary: Validated backend + frontend ChatGPT integration for Watch-Dawg: health endpoint, AI SSE streaming, MongoDB persistence, scenario-triggered AI generation, invalid JSON resilience, and node regression suite.
action_items: Optional hardening: remove plaintext EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from tracked backend/.env and inject via secret management.
Optional maintainability: split /app/index.html (>700 lines) into smaller modules/components.
critical_code_review_comments: Security: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is stored in plain text in /app/backend/.env (sensitive secret exposure risk).
Maintainability: /app/index.html is large (>700 lines), which increases regression risk and slows safe iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed pytest backend API checks against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with real SSE AI responses and Mongo persistence verification; all 3 backend tests passed. Browser automation validated ready-state no auto AI spend, anomaly/verified/ledger auto AI runs, invalid JSON REVIEW/0 resilience, and ChatGPT completion statuses. Node regression test.mjs passed.
rca of the issue: No functional defects reproduced in requested scope. Optional RCA: deterministic no-autospend behavior is implemented by initial runAudit({withAi:false}) followed by explicit AI panel reset, so AI calls happen only on user-triggered audits.
